rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the state or institution of marriage.

example.english: This marriage has lasted for more than ten years.
example.traditional: 呢段婚姻維持咗十幾年。
example.jyutping: nei1 dyun6 fan1 jan1 wai4 ci4 zo2 sap6 gei2 nin4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the wedding ceremony rather than the ongoing marriage.

example.english: Their marriage ceremony will be held next month.
example.traditional: 佢哋嘅婚禮下個月舉行。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ge3 fan1 lai5 haa6 go3 jyut6 geoi2 hang4

rows.note: Use this for an abstract close union of things or ideas, especially in formal discussion, not for a human marriage.

example.english: The marriage of technology and education can bring new breakthroughs.
example.traditional: 科技同教育嘅結合可以帶來新突破。
example.jyutping: fo1 gei6 tung4 gaau3 juk6 ge3 git3 hap6 ho2 ji5 daai3 loi4 san1 dat6 po3
